description: This file implements a sample client and server for RBus with OpenTelemetry support, including functions for handling trace context, property get/set callbacks, and method invocation.

methods.name: void run_client()
methods.description: Initializes RBus client, performs sample get/set/invoke operations with trace context handling.

methods.name: void run_manual_client()
methods.description: Performs manual test interactions for get/set/invoke with user-supplied trace context.

methods.name: void run_server()
methods.description: Sets up RBus server, registers data elements with handlers, and runs for a limited time.

methods.name: rbusError_t get_handler(rbusHandle_t rbus,rbusProperty_t prop,rbusGetHandlerOptions_t * opts)
methods.description: Handles RBus property get requests, sets a dummy value, and prints current trace context.

methods.name: rbusError_t set_handler(rbusHandle_t rbus,rbusProperty_t prop,rbusSetHandlerOptions_t * opts)
methods.description: Handles RBus property set requests and prints current trace context.

methods.name: rbusError_t method_handler(rbusHandle_t rbus,char const * methodName,rbusObject_t inParams,rbusObject_t outParams,rbusMethodAsyncHandle_t asyncHandle)
methods.description: Handles RBus method invocation, prints trace context, and returns 'Hello World' as output.

methods.name: void GetTraceContextFromUser(char * traceparent,char * tracestate)
methods.description: Reads traceparent and tracestate strings from user input for trace context simulation.

ctags.name: get_handler
ctags.pattern: /^rbusError_t get_handler(rbusHandle_t rbus, rbusProperty_t prop, rbusGetHandlerOptions_t* opts)$/

ctags.name: method_handler
ctags.pattern: /^rbusError_t method_handler(rbusHandle_t rbus, char const* methodName, rbusObject_t inParams,$/
ctags.signature: (rbusHandle_t rbus,char const * methodName,rbusObject_t inParams,rbusObject_t outParams,rbusMethodAsyncHandle_t asyncHandle)

ctags.name: set_handler
ctags.pattern: /^rbusError_t set_handler(rbusHandle_t rbus, rbusProperty_t prop, rbusSetHandlerOptions_t* opts)$/
